value.rationale: Uniform-matroid basis hypersurfaces are a canonical family adjacent to the known banana graph motivic computation. The theorem provides complete K0 and hence every Hodge–Deligne coefficient for all n≥5, as well as a parity-sensitive exponentially growing Euler invariant. Neither finite tests nor a singular-support criterion yield these global classes; they are determined by a motivated quadric-Cremona decomposition rather than an arbitrary slice.
